_about: Measured from the Synty Sidekick files in this project on 2026-10-08 (1,120 part FBX, SK_BaseModel, Side_Kick_Data.db). Regenerate if packs are added.

species_codes.HU: Human (also used by every outfit part)

armature.units: centimetres, Y up, in armature space

body_shape_keys.masculineFeminine: basis = masculine, 100 = feminine; the creator's neutral is 50
body_shape_keys.defaultBuff: basis = lean, 100 = muscular; the creator's neutral is 50

uv.note: cell (u,v) covers pixels [2u..2u+1] x [2v..2v+1], v counted from the bottom

attach_bone_movement._about: How far Sidekick moves each attach bone at 100 % of a body shape (sk_blend_shape_rig_movement): Unity local metres and Euler degrees in the bone's parent space. The game bakes the same table (CharacterDataBaker.BuildJointOffsets).
